lines.speaker: therapist
lines.text: Good to see you, Bill. How did the seminar go this week?

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: I went. My voice shook at the start, but after a minute it settled.

lines.speaker: therapist
lines.text: You went, and you stayed while your voice shook. What did you notice after that first minute?

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: That nobody seemed to care as much as I thought. A few people were even nodding.

lines.speaker: therapist
lines.text: That's worth remembering. Shall we write it down, so you can read it before the presentation?
